verdict.rationale: Sift's own machine-learning engine turns the customer's event data into risk scores (0–100) and flags users for review, which is a narrow, fraud-specific form of AI-generated insight surfaced in its console and Review Queues. There is no evidence of broader AI insights, natural-language explanations, or proactive suggestions. Missing for 10: general AI-generated insights or recommendations beyond fraud risk scores, explanations of why a score was given, in-product suggestion features, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Sift represents this risk with a score between 0 and 100, where risky events have higher scores.
